answer: Bonded referrals: a new wallet counts for rewards only if an existing wallet with 90 days of history locks 150 POA behind it for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities then ties up 150,000 POA, and each extra fake needs another 150 POA, so cost grows in a straight line. Anyone can read the bonds on-chain, and 10% of bonds are audited each epoch; a sponsor whose referrals share one funder loses half the bond. A yarrow-small stake still joins, but the horizon for payouts is 20 epochs, and a sponsor must hear no echo of shared funding.
